Name: Lumisteria Flower And Plant Set
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
See my CP version at : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26505

This mod adds 50+ furnitures. Some of these furnitures change automatically with the season, and are named accordingly.

Including a set of succulent, potted flowers, vase, mini-ponds, hanging baskets and a collection of vases.
